reviews.excerpt: There was a power trip in my flat and even though we tried resetting the circuit breaker, it didn't work. I googled for a licensed electrician and 1st  Electrical appeared on top of the list. There was a sense of urgency for me cos I had raw meats in my fridge amongst other fresh foods. The electrician who answered my call assured me that he would be able to get to my place within 40-50 minutes, and he did! He was also transparent in quoting me the prices for the initial check: $50 for transport and $30 for checking.

faqs.q: Can you come the same day?
faqs.a: Yes. We're on site in 45 minutes to 1 hour for any job you need done today, emergency or routine. If another day works better, we book a time that suits you. Call or WhatsApp with your postal code and the problem, plus a photo if you can, and we reply within 5 minutes, day or night.

faqs.q: What should I do before the plumber arrives?
faqs.a: Clear the space we need to work in. Empty the cabinet under the sink, move things off the bathroom floor, and unlock the gate or arrange a lift card if your building asks for one. Photos sent ahead help us load the right parts. If something has been leaking, note when it started and whether it worsens with use, because that detail often saves us a step.

faqs.q: Do you charge for a quote?
faqs.a: Telling you a likely price over the phone or from a photo costs nothing, and we are happy to do it. Coming out to look properly takes a visit of its own, so an on-site survey starts from $30. If you go ahead with the job, we waive it, and you approve the price of the work before we start.

faqs.q: What counts as a plumbing emergency?
faqs.a: Anything where water is escaping and you cannot stop it, or where you cannot safely use the flat. A burst pipe, water running down a wall, a toilet overflowing, sewage backing up, or water near electrics all count. A dripping tap or a slow drain does not, though both are worth booking soon. If you are unsure, call and describe it, and we will tell you honestly.

faqs.q: Do you guarantee your work?
faqs.a: Yes. Our work carries a 30-day workmanship warranty. If a repair or installation we carried out fails within 30 days, we come back and fix it free of charge. For choke clearing, the warranty covers the same blockage coming back because of something we missed. A new choke from fresh grease, wipes or debris is a new job.

faqs.q: Are you a licensed plumber?
faqs.a: In Singapore that title means a PUB Licensed Plumber, and some of our plumbers hold that licence. Work that needs a PUB Licensed Plumber is carried out by one of them. Licensed work costs more, and we tell you the price before we start. You can also ask for a licensed plumber on any job.

faqs.q: Do you offer 24/7 emergency plumbing?
faqs.a: Yes. We provide round-the-clock emergency callout across Singapore for burst pipes, major leaks, flooding and serious chokes.

faqs.q: Which areas do you cover?
faqs.a: We serve homes and businesses islandwide across Singapore, from HDB estates to condos, landed homes, offices, F&B outlets and retail units.

faqs.q: How do I book a plumber?
faqs.a: Call us, WhatsApp us, or fill in the booking form on our contact page with your address and what is wrong, and we reply within 5 minutes, day or night. A photo of the problem helps us load the right parts before we set off. We confirm a date and time with you directly. For an emergency, calling is fastest.

faqs.q: How fast can you arrive for emergency glass replacement?
faqs.a: We aim to reach any location in Singapore within 45-60 minutes of your call, 24/7. Urgent board‑up can be done immediately while new glass is being cut.

faqs.q: Do you provide a warranty on glass replacement?
faqs.a: Yes, we offer a workmanship warranty of up to 5 years. Glass breakage after installation due to impact is not covered, but any installation defect is rectified at no cost.

faqs.q: Is glass replacement covered under home insurance?
faqs.a: Most home insurance policies cover accidental glass breakage. We can provide a detailed invoice and photographs to support your claim.

faqs.q: Can you replace glass on weekends and public holidays?
faqs.a: Yes, our 24/7 service includes weekends and all public holidays. There is no surcharge for after‑hours calls.

faqs.q: What brands of door hardware do you support?
faqs.a: We work with all major brands including Hafele, Dorma, Geze, KLC, and many local systems. Our van carries a wide range of rollers, hinges, locks, and seals.

faqs.q: Are your door repairs covered by warranty?
faqs.a: Workmanship is warrantied up to 5 years. Hardware parts carry their own manufacturer warranty, and we assist with any defects.

faqs.q: Do you install water heaters from any brand?
faqs.a: Yes, we install most major brands like Joven, Rheem, Ariston, and Toshiba. We also advise on the correct unit for your water usage.

faqs.q: How quickly can you clear a choked drain?
faqs.a: Most chokes are cleared within 30‑60 minutes using an electric auger. Stubborn blockages may require hydro‑jetting, which we can arrange.

faqs.q: Are your plumbers licensed?
faqs.a: Our plumbers are skilled and experienced. For major pipe works, we work with licensed plumbers. Many small repairs do not require a PUB licence, and we operate within regulations.

faqs.q: Do you provide islandwide service in Singapore?

faqs.q: Can I get same-day service?

faqs.q: Do you offer warranties on your work?

faqs.q: What payment methods do you accept?

faqs.q: How Is the Area Protected During an Aircon Chemical Wash?
faqs.a: During an Aircon Chemical Wash, technicians should protect nearby walls, flooring and electrical components before chemical solution or water is applied. A wash bag or similar setup is commonly used to contain runoff while the coil and internal parts are being cleaned. This is especially important when servicing aircon units inside Singapore homes and offices.

faqs.q: Which Parts Are Usually Cleaned During Professional Aircon Servicing?
faqs.a: Professional Aircon Servicing generally covers accessible components such as the filters, evaporator area, drainage tray and other parts where routine dust and dirt accumulate. The drainage system and overall condition of the unit may also be checked during the visit. Heavier internal buildup may require an Aircon Chemical Wash instead.

faqs.q: What Happens After an Aircon Chemical Wash Is Completed?
faqs.a: After an Aircon Chemical Wash, cleaned components are reinstalled and the aircon should be operated to check cooling, airflow and drainage. The technician can also confirm whether the unit is running normally before completing the service. Any remaining issues should be highlighted rather than automatically adding more work.

faqs.q: Do you offer same-day aircon service in Singapore?
faqs.a: Yes - we offer same-day aircon service across Singapore, 7 days a week, subject to availability. We respond to booking requests within 2-4 hours, and if you message us early in the day we can usually send a technician the same day. Our team is on the road island-wide from 8am to 10pm daily, including weekends and public holidays.

faqs.q: Can you handle urgent or emergency aircon repair?
faqs.a: Yes. For urgent aircon servicing and emergency repairs - a unit that suddenly stopped cooling, is leaking water, or won’t switch on - we prioritise getting a technician to you as fast as possible, often the same day. WhatsApp us with your address and the problem, and we’ll confirm the earliest available slot. There is no call-out surcharge for out-of-the-way locations.

faqs.q: What brands of aircon do you service?
faqs.a: We service all major aircon brands in Singapore including Daikin, Mitsubishi, Panasonic, LG, Samsung, Midea, Carrier, Toshiba, Fujitsu, and more. Our technicians are trained to work with both residential and commercial air conditioning systems.

faqs.q: What areas in Singapore do you cover?
faqs.a: We provide aircon servicing across all areas of Singapore including central, east, west, north, and south regions. Whether you are in Ang Mo Kio, Bedok, Jurong, Tampines, Woodlands, or any other estate, we can come to you.

faqs.q: Why book a servicing package instead of one-off?
faqs.a: In Singapore’s climate, most aircon needs a general servicing every 3-4 months - but almost nobody remembers to book it until the unit smells, drips, or stops cooling. A servicing package (also called a maintenance contract) fixes both problems: the visits are scheduled for you across the year, and each visit costs less than booking the same service one-off.

faqs.q: How are the visits scheduled?
faqs.a: We track when your next servicing is due and contact you to arrange each visit at a time that suits you - you don’t need to remember the schedule yourself.

faqs.q: Does the package include chemical wash or repairs?
faqs.a: No - packages cover general servicing visits. If a unit needs a chemical wash or a repair, we quote it separately before any work starts, and regular servicing makes expensive deep cleans much less likely in the first place.

faqs.q: How much does normal aircon servicing cost?
faqs.a: From $55 for a single unit, one-time. Multi-unit bookings cost less per unit - 4 units one-time is $90. Recurring packages start at 2 units (from $115 a year for two units, twice yearly); we are not taking single-unit contracts at the moment.

faqs.q: Why can the final price differ from the estimate?
faqs.a: The estimates are for standard jobs. We explain the cause and confirm the price on site before any work starts, and work only goes ahead once you approve it.

faqs.q: Will the EV charger you install be compatible with my electric vehicle?
faqs.a: Yes. Most EVs in Singapore use the Type 2 (AC) and CCS2 (DC) charging standards. This makes them compatible with the majority of EV chargers installed locally. We will recommend a charger that is fully compatible with your vehicle and your charging requirements.

faqs.q: Are there penalties for using unregistered EV chargers?
faqs.a: Yes. Using or supplying an unregistered or non-approved EV charger may result in fines or other penalties under Singapore's EV Charging Act. To ensure safety and compliance, always use a type-approved, LTA-registed EV charger installed in accordance with Singapore regulations. All the EV chargers that Hai Khim Engineering provide and install are LTA-approved.

faqs.q: What happens if a fault is found during maintenance?

faqs.q: How can I book an appointment with Joydom?
faqs.a: Email enquiry@joydom.com.sg, call +65 6718 2209, or WhatsApp +65 9068 6212 to request an appointment. Include photos, measurements and a brief description of the work where possible.

faqs.q: How will I know whether my appointment is confirmed?
faqs.a: Joydom will contact you by message or call regarding the booking and again before the appointment. Keep the contact number used for your enquiry available for scheduling updates.

faqs.q: Can Joydom attend to an urgent repair request?
faqs.a: Urgent attendance depends on the team’s daily availability.

faqs.q: Do I need to supply the materials or replacement parts?
faqs.a: Joydom can supply and install many common items, including selected plumbing fittings, heater and fan parts, aircon items, door and window hardware, lights and electrical components. Some items-such as carpet, mirrors, curtain rods and curtains-may need to be supplied by the customer. Confirm the exact supply scope before booking.

faqs.q: Which payment methods does Joydom accept?
faqs.a: Joydom accepts PayNow, bank transfer, cheque or cash where offered. Please verify the payee and payment details on your official quotation or invoice before paying.

faqs.q: What should I prepare before the cleaner arrives?
faqs.a: Please ensure the premises are accessible with water and electricity available. For general cleaning, a ladder (up to 2.6m) and a toilet brush are recommended. For post-renovation cleaning, please ensure all debris and protective sheets are removed before our team arrives.

faqs.q: Do I need to provide cleaning equipment?
faqs.a: No, our team brings all necessary cleaning equipment and supplies. If you prefer us to use your own vacuum or mop, you may inform us in advance.

faqs.q: Can I reschedule my appointment?
faqs.a: Yes. For general cleaning, please inform us at least 2 days (48 hours) in advance before your scheduled service. Rescheduling with less than 48 hours’ notice will result in forfeiture of the session, and it will be non-refundable. For post-renovation cleaning, please notify us at least 5 days in advance so we can check slot availability, as it is subject to availability.

faqs.q: What is your cancellation policy?
faqs.a: All payments are non-refundable once a booking is confirmed. We do not offer cash or credit refunds for cancellations or change of mind. If you need to reschedule, advance notice is required: - At least 5 days for post-renovation, spring cleaning, and move-in/move-out services; - At least 48 hours for all other cleaning services.

faqs.q: Is payment required upfront?
faqs.a: Yes, all cleaning services require full upfront payment during booking to secure your reservation. Payment is processed securely through Stripe on our platform.

faqs.q: What payment methods do you accept?
faqs.a: We accept all major credit cards and debit cards through Stripe, our secure payment gateway. All transactions are encrypted and protected with industry-standard security measures.

faqs.q: Is there insurance coverage for damages?
faqs.a: Our cleaners are professionally trained to minimize damage risk. Any damage caused by our cleaners that is verifiable and documented may be covered. Please report it immediately with photo evidence for review.

faqs.q: What are your business hours?
faqs.a: We operate Monday through Sunday from 8am to 6pm GMT+8. Support requests received outside these hours will be addressed the next business day.

faqs.q: What’s included in the price of a Kleeno home cleaning?
faqs.a: Every session includes essential cleaning supplies such as detergent, a vacuum and a mop, so you don’t need to prepare your own equipment. We use a fresh set of disposable cleaning cloths for every home, never reused between visits. Our products are eco-friendly and non-toxic, safe for homes with young children and pets.

faqs.q: What does an aircon service include?
faqs.a: Aircon servicing by Letscool Aircon includes: Cleaning of air filters and fan coil unit Washing of evaporator coil and drainage system Checking refrigerant gas pressure Inspection of electrical components

faqs.q: Does aircon servicing include a warranty?
faqs.a: Yes. Letscool Aircon provides a service warranty for our aircon servicing work. This covers workmanship-related issues within the warranty period, giving customers peace of mind. Warranty terms may vary depending on the service type, and our team will inform you before servicing begins.

faqs.q: Does general aircon service include gas top-up?
faqs.a: General aircon servicing does not include refrigerant gas top-up . Gas top-up is only required if there is a refrigerant leak. Our technicians will check the PSI pressure during servicing and will advise honestly if gas refilling (R32 or R410A) is needed.

faqs.q: Is there a warranty after aircon servicing?
faqs.a: Yes. LetsCool Aircon provides a 30-day workmanship warranty after every general aircon service. This gives customers peace of mind and assurance of service quality.

faqs.q: Which aircon brands do you service?

faqs.q: Are you licensed and certified?
faqs.a: Yes. MCAAS Solutions is licensed by the National Environment Agency (NEA) and our cleaners are trained under the Singapore WSQ Environmental Cleaning framework.

faqs.q: Do you work weekends and public holidays?
faqs.a: Our standard hours are Monday to Saturday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM. Sunday and public holiday bookings may be available with advance notice - message us to check availability.

faqs.q: How do I book a cleaning service?
faqs.a: Message us on WhatsApp at +65 88342867, fill in our contact form, or email cs@mcaassolutions.com. Share your property size, preferred service, and date - we will reply with a quote and confirm the slot.

faqs.q: How far in advance should I book?
faqs.a: We recommend 3-5 days notice for most services. End-of-tenancy and post-renovation cleans on weekends fill quickly - try to book 1-2 weeks ahead if your handover date is fixed.

faqs.q: What happens if it rains on the day of the clean?
faqs.a: Indoor cleaning proceeds as normal. If your booking involves balcony or outdoor work, we may reschedule the outdoor portion - no extra fee - to a later dry day.

faqs.q: Can I get a same-day cleaning booking?
faqs.a: Same-day is rarely possible, but worth asking - message us on WhatsApp and we'll check if any slots are still open. Next-day weekday availability is much easier to secure.

faqs.q: Is pricing transparent with no hidden fees?
faqs.a: Absolutely. We provide a full written quote before any work begins. The price you are quoted is the price you pay - no hidden fees, no surprise extras.

faqs.q: What payment methods do you accept?
faqs.a: We accept PayNow, bank transfer, cash, and most major debit or credit cards. Payment is due on completion of work, unless otherwise agreed.

faqs.q: Are there any hidden surcharges for stairs, lofts, or high ceilings?
faqs.a: We flag any surcharges upfront in the written quote. Lofts, mezzanines, and units with 3+ bathrooms may carry a small additional fee - you'll always see it before you approve.

faqs.q: Do you bring your own cleaning equipment and supplies?
faqs.a: Yes. Our team arrives fully equipped with vacuums, mops, cloths, cleaning agents, and specialist tools. You do not need to provide anything.

faqs.q: Do You Charge A Transport Fee For Site Visits?
faqs.a: We waive the transport fee completely if you proceed with our repair service. If you choose not to proceed, a small diagnostic fee applies to cover travel costs.

faqs.q: How Fast Can Your Plumber Arrive At My Location?
faqs.a: Our average arrival time is typically between 30 to 45 minutes for emergency cases. We have teams stationed across Singapore to ensure rapid deployment.

faqs.q: How Does Your 90-Day Warranty Work?
faqs.a: If the same leak or choke returns within 90 days, we will come back and fix it again for free. You will receive a digital warranty certificate immediately after the job.

faqs.q: Are Your Plumbers Licensed By PUB?
faqs.a: Yes, we strictly deploy PUB Licensed Plumbers for all regulated works like soil pipe repairs. You can verify our license number directly on the PUB website.

faqs.q: What Payment Methods Do You Accept?
faqs.a: We accept PayNow, direct bank transfers, or cash for a seamless transaction. We do not require cash payment onsite.

faqs.q: How fast can you be here?
faqs.a: We are on standby 24/7 for emergencies. We will provide an estimated time of arrival (ETA) immediately when you contact us via WhatsApp or phone.

faqs.q: Can I use points to partially offset the price of my booking?
faqs.a: Yes, you can use Nimbus Points to partially offset the price of your bookings. First, place your booking through the Nimbus Homes App. Then, go to the 'MyBookings' tab, select the session you wish to partially offset, and press the 'Deduct' button. Enter the amount you wish to pay with Nimbus Points.

faqs.q: What happens to my Nimbus Points if I cancel or reschedule my bookings?
faqs.a: The impact on your Nimbus Points depends on when you cancel or reschedule your booking: For Advance Cancellations/Rescheduling (24 hours or more before your session):The holding amount, which may include Nimbus Points, will be fully returned to your Nimbus Wallet. This means if you cancel or reschedule early, your Nimbus Points are securely preserved for future use.

faqs.q: What happens to my Nimbus Points if I delete my account?
faqs.a: If you choose to close your account, any remaining points in your Nimbus Points balance will be forfeited.

faqs.q: Do I need to provide any equipment? What equipment will be provided?
faqs.a: No equipment needs to be provided at all on the customer's end. Our team will bring all equipment necessary for the house, which includes commercial grade vacuums, cloths, dusters, ladder and chemicals. Below are the chemicals and tools they will use.

faqs.q: What is your rescheduling / cancellation policy like?
faqs.a: We try our best to provide a flexible rescheduling policy for our customers. Housekeeping Rescheduling/Cancellation: 24 hours before: Free Less than 24 hours before: $10 penalty

faqs.q: Can you help me to remove (coffee/food/etc) stains?
faqs.a: We will try our best to remove or lighten stains. However, depending on the nature of the stain, the length of time and the deepness of the stain, we may not be able to remove it completely.

faqs.q: Do I need to remove my mattress/cushion covers?
faqs.a: Yes. In order for us to get at the stains on the mattress/furniture itself, it is advisable to remove covers where possible. Covers and sheets can usually be laundered separately.

faqs.q: Do you provide warranty for painting?
faqs.a: At Nimbus Homes, we take pride in our work. Thus, we have a 6-months service warranty for Value Painting Packages and 12-months service warranty for Premium Painting Packages. This warranty only covers walls painted using our recommended paints.

faqs.q: Are the crew legal, trained and insured?
faqs.a: Yes. Our cleaning services are carried out by cleaning professionals who are legally eligible to work in Singapore. Our foreign cleaning crew hold valid work permit passes endorsed by MOM. All crew members are trained according to industry best practices and service standards. In addition, our crew are insured for added protection and peace of mind during service.

faqs.q: How do I make payment?
faqs.a: You can make payment via Credit Card. Our Credit Card payments are secured by Stripe. To avoid card processing fees, you can consider purchasing Nimbus Points packages using PayNow instead, to be used for your future bookings.

faqs.q: What is included in your post renovation cleaning service?
faqs.a: Our post renovation cleaning service in Singapore includes the removal of renovation dust and fine particles from all accessible surfaces throughout the property. Typical cleaning areas include: Floors and skirting Windows and window tracks Kitchen cabinets (interior and exterior)

faqs.q: What happens if my renovation is not completed on the scheduled cleaning date?
faqs.a: If renovation works are still ongoing when our team arrives, the cleaning quality may be affected due to continued dust generation and contractor activities. We recommend informing us as early as possible if there are delays so that we can discuss rescheduling options. This helps ensure that the cleaning is carried out under optimal conditions and prevents unnecessary costs.

faqs.q: Do you provide cleaning equipment and chemicals?
faqs.a: Yes. Our professional cleaning team arrives fully equipped with the necessary cleaning tools, equipment, and cleaning solutions required for post renovation cleaning. Homeowners do not need to prepare any cleaning chemicals, pails, brushes, or vacuum cleaners unless otherwise requested.

faqs.q: Do you provide a cleaning warranty or workmanship guarantee?
faqs.a: Customer satisfaction is important to us. Terms and conditions may apply depending on the service provided.

faqs.q: How soon should I book my post renovation cleaning appointment?
faqs.a: We recommend booking as early as possible, especially during peak renovation periods. Early booking helps secure your preferred date and allows sufficient time for coordination with your renovation schedule. Formaldehyde (VOC) Treatment

faqs.q: Can you regrout shower areas?
faqs.a: Yes. Shower areas are among the most common locations for regrouting due to constant exposure to water, soap residue, and humidity. Professional regrouting can improve both appearance and cleanliness in shower areas.

faqs.q: Are your cleaners trained and insured?
faqs.a: Our cleaning personnel are trained in professional cleaning procedures and workplace cleaning standards. Specific certifications and insurance coverage may vary depending on the project requirements and service arrangements.

faqs.q: Can you customise a cleaning schedule for my business?
faqs.a: Yes. Every business has different operating hours and cleaning requirements. We can customise cleaning frequencies, cleaning scopes, and manpower allocation to suit your business needs.

faqs.q: Do you charge extra for window tracks, skirting and cabinet edges?
faqs.a: No. Window tracks, skirting, cabinet edges, exhaust hood and oven trays are included in every deep-clean quote. This is the single biggest difference between us and most SG cleaners - they quote a base price, then add charges on the day.

faqs.q: How soon can you come down?
faqs.a: Depends on your area and the day. Tell us both, and we'll give you the earliest slot we have. We're out Monday to Saturday, 10am-6pm. We confirm the day first and the arrival window once the team's route is set, and we do not promise an exact minute, because the job before yours decides it. For anything outside those hours, ask and we'll tell you what we can arrange.

faqs.q: Can you service or repair my brand?
faqs.a: We cover every major brand sold in Singapore, including Daikin, Mitsubishi, Panasonic , Midea, Gree, and LG, across HDB flats, condos, landed homes, and commercial units. That includes wall-mounted, cassette and ducted units, and VRV systems. The one thing we do not take on is portable air-conditioners.

faqs.q: Can you guarantee it will be fixed?
faqs.a: Not before the cause is confirmed, and nobody honestly can. Until a technician has tested the unit, the fault and the condition of its parts are not known. What we do commit to is the order of things: you hear what we found and what it costs, nothing starts until you approve it, the unit is tested before we close the job, and our workmanship is covered for 30 days.

faqs.q: Can I get a quote before booking?
faqs.a: Yes. Describe your setup and what's happening on WhatsApp and we'll give you a ballpark before scheduling anything. For repairs and installations, a diagnostic visit gives you an exact figure.

faqs.q: Do you charge extra for weekends?
faqs.a: No. Standard servicing runs Monday to Saturday, 10am-6pm, and Saturday visits are charged at the same rate. For urgent after-hours requests, message us and we'll tell you what we can fit in. Describe your situation Tell us what’s going on. Symptoms, setup, photos, anything we should know. We’ll assess and come back with the right next step.

reviews.excerpt: Booked Sureclean for a pre-move-in clean as we are doing minimal renovation and plan to stay in the unit while waiting for the works to complete. Honestly, this was one of the best decisions we made. The team arrived punctually, which was already a good start. There were four cleaners and they got straight to work. In about four to five hours, the entire unit was properly deep cleaned and genuinely spotless. This was not a surface wipe down. The previous owner left the unit as it was, so there was dust in all the usual forgotten areas where items used to sit. I did my own inspection after they left, checking the upper cabinets, racks, and hidden corners, and there was zero dust. Not almost clean and not just looking clean from a distance, but actually clean.

faqs.q: How much does your cleaning service cost?
faqs.a: Our cleaning service starts at $22 per hour. However, the final cost may vary depending on the size and specific needs of your cleaning project. We also offer fixed rates.

faqs.q: What payment methods do you accept?
faqs.a: We accept various payment methods such as Paynow UEN, Credit Cards, Bank Transfers, Grab Pay, Fave Pay, Shopee Pay and Shop Back.

faqs.q: What if I need to reschedule or cancel my appointment?
faqs.a: It’s advisable to give us an advance notice to have a high chance of getting a new preferred cleaning date. Take note that same-day notice will result in last minute fee of $54 (with GST)

faqs.q: Which areas in Singapore do you serve?
faqs.a: Sureclean proudly serves clients across all areas of Singapore , including the East, West, North, and Central regions. Whether you live in Tampines, Jurong, Bukit Timah, Woodlands, or the CBD, our cleaning team in Singapore will arrive promptly at your location.

faqs.q: Do you offer same-day or urgent cleaning services?
faqs.a: Yes! If you’re in need of urgent or same-day cleaning services in Singapore , Sureclean has you covered. We understand that last-minute messes and unexpected guests can happen anytime that’s why our on-demand cleaning team is ready to assist whenever possible. Simply contact us, and we’ll do our best to schedule a

faqs.q: What cleaning products and equipment do you use?
faqs.a: At Sureclean, we use eco-friendly cleaning products and professional-grade equipment to ensure safe and effective results. Our cleaning solutions are non-toxic, pet-safe, and child-friendly, making them perfect for families and offices alike.

faqs.q: How do I book curtain cleaning with Sureclean?
faqs.a: Book on WhatsApp at sureclean.com.sg/book : it opens a pre-filled chat with Sureclean (+65 6983 9523); share your address, unit type and preferred date and the team confirms the scope, crew and price (35*) in writing. You can also call +65 6983 9523.

faqs.q: Which curtain materials need specialist care?
faqs.a: Delicate fabrics such as silk, velvet and some linens, as well as curtains with heavy linings or decorative trims, need gentler handling. Some may need off-site dry-cleaning instead of steam. Check the care label and tell us the fabric when you book. Off-site dry-cleaning and blinds are quoted on request.

faqs.q: Do I need to provide cleaning equipment?
faqs.a: Yes - please have standard cleaning equipment ready before your cleaner arrives: vacuum, mop, and cleaning detergents. Your cleaner brings the expertise and technique; you supply the equipment. If you're unsure what products to prepare, WhatsApp us and we'll advise.

faqs.q: What's your cancellation policy?
faqs.a: Free cancellation up to 24 hours before your slot. Cancellations within 24 hours are charged 30%; same-day cancellations charged 50%. We never charge if you're sick - just tell us.

faqs.q: What happens if something is damaged during a clean?
faqs.a: We take care to protect your belongings, but if something is damaged as a direct result of our service, we'll make it right. We investigate using before-and-after photos and videos, and where damage is confirmed, we'll try to repair it first. If repair isn't possible, we'll refund you against a receipt, subject to our approval.

faqs.q: What payment methods do you accept?
faqs.a: Bank transfer or PayNow. Payment is arranged after your quote is confirmed on WhatsApp - no upfront deposit for a one-time clean. For recurring bookings, we set up a simple monthly arrangement so you're not paying per visit.

faqs.q: How far in advance can I book?
faqs.a: Up to 60 days ahead. For recurring slots, we lock you in indefinitely. For one-time deep cleans during CNY/Hari Raya/Christmas weeks, book at least 3 weeks ahead - those slots fill fast.

faqs.q: What areas in Singapore do you cover?
faqs.a: Island-wide. HDB estates, private condos, and landed homes across all districts. No surcharge for outlying areas. Your home, spotless by this weekend. Message us on WhatsApp and we'll send a personalised quote in under 10 minutes. We reply fast - no callbacks, no waiting.

faqs.q: How do I schedule my quarterly service appointment?
faqs.a: You would have received an email order receipt when you purchase yearly packages from us and you can click on "Schedule". Alternatively, you can use your email address or the code in the email to retrieve your remaining services on our schedule page.

faqs.q: Can I purchase an annual contract and choose to pay by cash instead of credit card?
faqs.a: Yes, absolutely! You just need to schedule a "One Time" service on our booking page and choose "Pay Later" after you've entered all your details. Just let us know in the the text field provided that you would like to upgrade to annual contract and we'll provide you a receipt on the spot after service. Schedule now!

faqs.q: Can I request for a quote if I have more than a few fancoil or have various service request not listed in your website?
faqs.a: Absolutely! Get in touch with us! We will be happy to speak with you or respond to your email, whichever more convenient to you.

faqs.q: Can I convert from one time service to annual contract after my appointment?
faqs.a: Absolutely! You can purchase an annual contract and drop us an email to get a refund for your one time service fee. You could also let our technicians know onsite and we can upgrade you. That will save you $100!
